notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (7): Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, Strike Planning, Menace Fades, Squadron Assignments, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Rendezvous Point, Chandrila (the Hidden Base system); these count toward the 60 (total 60 as published). Three Effects start, none named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Posted 'Chandrila (hidden base)' dested the Light Endor-set Chandrila system (the system holding the Hidden Base). Chandrila is also listed again under Systems (5); both rows are kept as published.
Posted 'Grabber' x3 does not name the card; kept as written (UNKNOWN).
Posted 'Kiffex' dested the Light Jabba's Palace system Kiffex (Jabba's Palace) (the plain Kiffex page is the Dark A New Hope printing).

Posted 'Endor' dested Endor (Light); 'Tawass Khaa' dested Tawss Khaa; 'Yarna d al Gargan' dested Yarna d'al' Gargan; 'Out of Comission' dested Out Of Commission; 'Obi-Wan w/ Lightsaber', 'Luke w/ Lightsaber' and 'Leia w/ Blaster Rifle' dested the Enhanced Premiere characters.
Posted 'Do, Or Do Not/Wise Advice' and 'Control/Tunnel Vision' dested as the combo cards.

The description calls it an updated version of the same author's 'Hidden Base is fun' (DeckTech 15634, 29 April 2001); this list drops Hoth and Coruscant and adds Projection Of A Skywalker and The Signal. The strategy's system pull order still names Coruscant, which is not in this list.
